description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionDao class which provides methods to manage EmailNotification entities, including fetching, counting, retrieving by ID, and saving email subscriptions. It interacts with the database using Doctrine ORM and supports pagination and filtering functionality.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing email subscriptions in the OrangeHRM system, enables retrieval, counting, and persistence of EmailNotification entities using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailNotification entities based on filtering parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of email subscriptions according to search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionListCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of email subscriptions matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmailNotification entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscription
methods.description: Persists a given EmailNotification entity into the database.
